about.heading: Taught by someone who *learned by doing*
about.body:
My name is Valentina, and I’m Italian. I studied foreign languages and communication at the University of Turin, spent a year studying English at the University of Glamorgan in Wales, and learned Spanish at Proyecto Español, a language school in Alicante. After that I spent seventeen years with an Italian multinational fashion company, training and coaching store teams across Europe, the Middle East and Russia.

Nobody learns to run a shop floor from a textbook, and nobody learns to speak from one either. You learn by doing it, with someone who corrects you kindly and keeps you talking. That is how I teach.

I live in Atlanta now, and I teach every lesson myself: adults, teens and kids, one-on-one and in small groups, in person or online. I also teach for four language schools.

items.q: I tried before and it didn’t stick. Why would this be different?
items.a: Many courses start with rules and leave speaking for later. Here it is the other way round. You talk from the first lesson, about things you care about, and the grammar comes in when you need it.

items.q: Do I need to know anything before I start?
items.a: No. You can start from zero. Tell me why you want to learn and I build the first lessons around that.

items.q: How often should I take lessons?
items.a: I suggest two hours a week: enough to make progress, light enough to keep up.

items.q: In person or online, which is better?
items.a: Both work the same way. In person is nice if you are in the Atlanta metro area and have the time; online saves the traffic and lets you learn from anywhere.

items.q: Do you teach teens and kids?
items.a: Yes. I teach adults, teens and kids. The lessons follow the student’s age, level and goals.

items.q: What happens in the free 15-minute call?
items.a: You tell me why you want to learn and where you are now. By the end you know your level, the format that fits your week and what the first month looks like. No obligation.

There is no price list here because no two plans are the same: one-on-one or a group, once or twice a week, in person or online. After the free call you get your price in writing, and you decide then.
